adaptation: The five retained implementation files are copied byte-for-byte. Public execution now uses genus-one third-point routines and the genus-two d=5 specialization; higher genera remain outside the public interface.
scope: Retained project mathematics is unrefereed; this is reuse plus independent finite validation, not a new theorem or external certification.

fifth_formula_source.implementation: New interval wrapper with shared products; formulas preserved; independent derivation in FIFTHS.md.

output_contract_extension: Version 0.4 adds full/u_only modes in the wrapper services. Retained mathematical kernels are unchanged. OUTPUT_MODES.md classifies the zero-multiplier cases and distinguishes skipped boundaries from zero values.

bgs_backend_extension.implementation: New scalar AP interpolation shifts and recursive block construction; explicit field-only known-node collision handling; existing exact polynomial multiplier reused. See BGS_BACKEND.md.

shared_boundary_extension.implementation: New built-in ratio planner, Wilson canonicalization, per-call exact product reuse, sorted factorial gap reuse and shared ratio-denominator batch inversion. Existing third/fifth reduction formulas preserved.

many_prime_forest.use: Existing integer triangular-matrix product and accumulating remainder-tree kernels; new scheduler and output wrapper. Original rounded-third forest remains available unchanged.

measured_dispatch_extension.implementation: New exact local workload calibration profiles and measured forest/independent kernel selection. many_primes.py schedule preflight extracted for reuse; retained arithmetic kernels unchanged.
measured_dispatch_extension.scope: Opt-in dispatch; explicit engines/default forest retained; no extrapolation or universal hardware model.

consolidation_release.scope: Public facade, runtime manifest, portable evidence capture and two dispatch profile error-handling fixes. Mathematical kernels unchanged.
consolidation_release.review_status: AI-assisted bounded release audit; no independent specialist certification or current-version Windows execution claimed.
